title: Parse explicit calendar dates in the Rayuela inbox
notes: An authorized first-page inbox comparison found 33 of 200 rows with a portal date in DD/MM/YYYY format and a missing ISO date in the CLI.
done_when: The read-only inbox comparison reproduces the portal calendar dates for all rows on the first page, including explicit dates.
result: Parse explicit calendar dates in the Rayuela inbox
evidence: After pnpm build, an authorized read on 2026-11-27 matched the ISO dates on all 200 first-page rows against raw portal labels. All 33 DD/MM/YYYY rows now resolve; the focused Rayuela suite also covers invalid dates, leap days and an ambiguous response day.
